_note: Character creation (Brent 2026-10-11: 'feel a lot like BG3 - naming, character design (look), gender... then the prime selection'). Identity sets how the character is referred to and, through its 'sex', the shape of the body (the look key 'sex'); body type is chosen separately and nothing here affects stats. Non-binary was removed for now at Brent's request. Names are original to this project. Look options themselves come from the model library (Models.look_options).

hidden_options._note: look options not offered for a given sex: sex -> key -> [ids]. Beards on the female face were the art agent's recommendation to hide; the model can still render them.
